title: Minecraft Level Up
blurb: Bright, ascending and faintly magical, this is the chime that tells you the enchanting table is finally worth walking over to. Minecraft's progression sounds all exist to make repetitive work feel earned, and this is the best of them: thirty levels of mining collapsed into one satisfying sparkle. It is short enough to spam and pleasant enough that nobody much minds when you do. Play it when you achieve something, when a colleague achieves something, or when you get out of bed before ten and feel strongly that ought to count for experience points.
